description: 土砂災害警戒区域データ [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 都道府県が指定する土砂災害警戒区域の範囲または位置、及び種別、名称等のデータを以下の内容のGISデータとして整備したものです。 ①区域区分 ・土砂災害警戒区域（イエローゾーン） ・土砂災害特別警戒区域（レッドゾーン） ②現象の種類 ・急傾斜地の崩壊 ・土石流 ・地すべり. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (some restrictions). Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
